summary: Iter-23 verified the new child SRN/ERN tracking feature. New 5-test suite (TC1-TC5) passes 100% (5/5). Iter-21 regression suite still 17/17 PASS. Backend now correctly stamps `children: [{child_srn_id|child_ern_id, child_(srn|ern)_no, short_qty|extra_qty, created_at}]` on each parent SRN/ERN item that contributed residual when a child is auto-created. parent_rn_id propagates to original RN across all 3 chain levels.
critical_code_review_comments: _auto_create_srn_for_rn / _auto_create_ern_for_rn correctly perform a 2nd update_one on the parent doc to push the children[] entry. Implementation is idempotent per (part_no, make) key — but a pathological re-finalize could in principle append a duplicate entry. Currently 409 on already-COMPLETE docs prevents this, so safe in practice.
Children entry uses 'created_at' from the new child doc which itself uses now_iso() — consistent and resolvable.
parent_rn_id propagates correctly through the entire 3-level chain (verified TC4: grandchild.parent_rn_id == original RN.id).
Suggestion (non-blocking): Consider adding a unique-by-child_id guard in the children[] push to be defensive against future re-finalize semantics changes.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates fresh TESTPN_<uuid8> stock_master rows, TEST_GD_/TR/TB godown/rack/box, and TESTMK make per run; no pre-existing seed dependency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-23 added child-tracking validation. New regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter23_child_tracking.py (5 tests covering TC1 simple RN->RKN, TC2 child SRN tracking, TC3 child ERN tracking, TC4 3-level SRN chain, TC5 child IDs resolvable). Run with `export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://inventory-ops-dash.preview.emergentagent.com && pytest backend/tests/test_iter23_child_tracking.py backend/tests/test_iter21_status_workflow.py -v`. All 22/22 pass. Frontend dialog updates (Test Case 5 'all clickable links work') were NOT tested per request — backend confirms child IDs are resolvable via GET /api/short-received-notes/{id} and GET /api/extra-received-notes/{id}.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature verification, no bug found. New behavior fully matches spec: parent SRN/ERN items[].children array correctly populated with {child_id, child_no, residual_qty, created_at} after finalize spawns child; chain back-references (parent_srn_id/parent_ern_id, parent_rn_id) preserved across multi-level chains.
